key_sections_summary: Treatment 175 IU/kg daily; CrCl <30 not recommended, anti-Xa 0.5–1.5 IU/mL 4–6 h if used; no accumulation to CrCl 20; hyperkalemia risk; t1/2 3.7 h (2.5 h IV in dialysis).
note: Our paraphrase of the regulator product information; numbers copied exactly. Not rendered as text.
